text: Psychiatry and mental health is a branch of clinical medicine that studies the occurrence, development patterns, prevention and treatment of mental disorders, covering the etiology, pathology, diagnosis, treatment, rehabilitation and public health intervention of mental diseases. The course aims to cultivate students' mastery of the bio-psycho-social medical model of mental disorders, equip them with the capabilities of clinical diagnosis, psychological intervention and community mental health services, and at the same time focus on the cultivation of ethical literacy and humanistic care.
